metric: Production JavaScript adapter/library clean rebuild, with warmed filesystem caches

scope.included: Selected engine, its imported loaders and the src/<engine>.js createScene adapter; fresh Node process per build.
scope.excluded: Common benchmark UI, scene JSON, GLB/textures/audio, browser startup/runtime, dependency installation, and post-build gzip/hash measurement.
scope.godot: Godot import/export timing is separate. Its exported runtime and packed project are not bit-identical to these JavaScript libraries; do not present export time or artifact size as the same metric.

methodology.orderRationale: Fixed Latin-square rotation gives each engine each within-round position once; all children run sequentially.
methodology.warmDefinition: One preliminary build per engine primes OS/filesystem caches and is excluded from summary statistics; every measured trial still starts a new Node/Vite process and clears its output directory. This is not HMR or an incremental-cache measurement.
methodology.clock: Monotonic process.hrtime.bigint around child spawn through close (including stdio shutdown); raw nanoseconds and milliseconds retained.
methodology.gzip: Sum of separately gzip-compressed emitted JavaScript files at zlib level 9; gzip work occurs after the timed process exits.

build.note: Vite ES library mode preserves whitespace/pure annotations needed by downstream tree-shaking. All three engines use the same library-build configuration.

methodology.isolation: Run with other CPU-heavy tasks and browsers paused; this script serializes its own work but cannot ensure the host is otherwise idle.
